item.title: Raksha Bandhan 2026: President Droupadi Murmu, PM Narendra Modi extend ‘heartfelt greetings’, celebrate its significance
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu and PM Narendra Modi extended heartfelt greetings on Raksha Bandhan. Droupadi Murmu underscored the festival's cultural significance, emphasizing the bonds of protection and mutual responsibility.

item.title: Worried you might not be able to see the partial lunar eclipse? Here's a list of YouTube channels offering livestreams
item.description: A partial lunar eclipse will darken around 96 per cent of the Moon on 28 August, with the event mainly visible across North and South America. Skywatchers elsewhere can catch the celestial spectacle through livestreams from observatories and astronomy platforms.

item.title: New York, Huntsville, Palm Desert: Which Red Lobster locations are closing in 2026? See complete list
item.description: In June, Red Lobster shuttered its Times Square restaurant after 23 years, leaving Manhattan without a single Red Lobster location. Here's the full list of Red Lobster locations getting shut down in 2026.

item.title: White House construction may have contributed to Trump's Marine One getting close to commercial jet - What we know
item.description: NTSB reported that ongoing White House construction contributed to radio communication issues, leading to a near-collision. Problems arose due to inadequate line-of-sight and relocation of Marine One during construction, prompting FAA action to improve communications.

item.title: Trump admin likely to sign a deal with Venezuela to access its oilfields: How will it work? What are the legal hurdles?
item.description: US President Donald Trump's administration is reportedly negotiating a deal for long-term US access to Venezuelan oilfields, potentially lowering oil import costs and boosting output. The proposal could involve long-term leases and US companies developing the fields.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today — 28 Aug: Fuel rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru as crude oil heads for weekly loss
item.description: Petrol and diesel prices today — 28 Aug: Fuel rates remained stable across major Indian cities, with no significant change.&nbsp;

item.title: CIA Chief John Ratcliffe gave bleak assessment of Russia-Ukraine war, urged Moscow to strike a deal with Kyiv: Reports
item.description: CIA Director John Ratcliffe met Russian intelligence heads in Moscow, assessing the Russia-Ukraine conflict and warning against attacks on NATO. He encouraged diplomacy to avoid escalating military and economic situations while the Kremlin dismissed U.S. concerns.

item.title: Kennedy Center's demolition will be an ‘eventuality’ if Trump's name isn't added, says Lutnick amid court hearing
item.description: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick on Thursday (local time) defended adding President Donald Trump's name to the Kennedy Center, arguing that the center's demolition will be an ‘eventuality’ if Trump's name isn't added.

item.title: ‘Earthquake-like manner’: How Iran vows to counter US economic warfare? Plan may include nuclear weapon, oil crackdown
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced 'Economic D-Day' sanctions aimed at crippling Iran's economy amid war with the US. Iranian officials have condemned the move and hinted at possible actions they may take to target the US economy in retaliation.

item.title: Happy Raksha Bandhan 2026 image: 150+ wishes, messages, greetings, captions for WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook status
item.description: Raksha Bandhan festival honours the brother-sister bond. Sisters tie rakhis on brothers' wrists, symbolizing protection and love. Let's have a look at specially curated wishes, messages, greetings, captions and images for WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook status.

item.title: Why the glacier collapse behind Nepal’s flash flood is a warning sign for the Himalayas
item.description: The Himalayas, Earth's youngest mountain system, face severe impacts from global warming, leading to rapid glacier melt. Recent flash floods in Nepal, triggered by a glacier collapse in Tibet, have caused heavy casualties and warnings of further risk from barrier lakes formed by melting glaciers.

item.title: GST Council may cut 18% tax on mobile phones as handset demand slows
item.description: The Council is also likely to examine whether the benefits of last year’s GST rate rationalization have been passed on to consumers, following complaints of companies restoring prices to pre-reform levels.

item.title: US-Iran war news LIVE Updates: Qatar PM meets Iranian officials; Tehran prepares conditions to open Strait of Hormuz
item.description: US-Iran war news LIVE Updates: Iran’s security chief Mohsen Rezaei reportedly said Tehran is preparing a list of conditions to open the Strait of Hormuz in response to a request by mediators.

item.title: Sugar spike puts FMCG margins under fresh pressure
item.description: Wholesale sugar prices have surged 40% in two months, threatening to exacerbate the margin squeeze for packaged food companies already reeling from higher input costs. The bigger question is whether rising food inflation could now threaten the durability of India’s consumption recovery.

item.description: The breach affected information connected to car park, lounge and Fast Track bookings, as well as in-airport Wi-Fi registrations at Manchester Airport, London Stansted Airport and East Midlands Airport.

item.title: Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’ with immediate effect as Canada trade war intensifies
item.description: US President Donald Trump has escalated his increasingly bitter trade dispute with Canada by proposing that Lake Ontario be renamed “Lake America”, a move that echoes his earlier push to rename the Gulf of Mexico as the Gulf of America.

item.title: Who is Karan Gupta? Indian-origin former Optum director sentenced to 3 years for ₹9 crore fraud
item.description: Indian-origin former Optum senior director Karan Gupta, 48, has been sentenced to 36 months in prison for defrauding the healthcare firm of more than $950,000 through a no-show job and kickback scheme involving his longtime friend.

item.title: ED seizes, freezes ₹33 crore assets of Vatika promoters in homebuyer 'fraud' case
item.description: The ED has seized and frozen assets worth ₹33 crore linked to Vatika Ltd promoters in a money laundering probe over alleged fraud with homebuyers. The agency alleged that plots worth ₹120 crore were delivered against ₹260.30 crore received.

item.title: India to get widespread rainfall over the week: IMD

item.title: Subhash Chandra's ₹6.5 cr payout to settle dues cleared by NCLT; Congress calls it ‘mundan’: Key things to know
item.description: The NCLT approved a resolution plan by Subhash Chandra to settle ₹22,006.57 crore in claims with only ₹6.5 crore, representing a 99.97% reduction. NCLT Member (Judicial) Nilesh Sharma, acting as the third member of the tribunal, approved the resolution plan on Tuesday under Section 114 of IBC.
